environment_hazards: Sandboxed gate runners cannot write outside the workspace. uv's default cache at ~/.cache/uv fails with `Operation not permitted (os error 1)` on .cache/uv/sdists-v9/.git, so pyproject.toml sets [tool.uv] cache-dir = ".uv-cache". Do not remove it.

uv older than 0.12 panics under a macOS sandbox inside system-configuration 0.6.1 (SCDynamicStore, 'Attempted to create a NULL object'), which fails every `uv build` variant. Requires uv >= 0.12. Upstream: astral-sh/uv#18629.

Sandboxed gate runners have no network (DNS resolution fails). A fresh worktree has neither .venv nor a warm .uv-cache, so gates cannot bootstrap there. Before running gates in a new worktree, seed it by copying the primary checkout's warm .uv-cache into the worktree root; uv then builds .venv offline. Verified: seeded worktree passes all five gates offline.
Warm the primary cache with `uv sync --all-groups` before seeding. A .uv-cache created while .venv already exists stays nearly empty and is not a usable seed.
lockfile_rules: uv.lock is tracked; dependency changes must commit the updated lockfile alongside pyproject.toml.
